name: Altera Via
source:
Altera Via follows a young university student as he navigates everyday life, friendships, unexpected encounters, and increasingly complicated relationships.

Between his university life and the time he spends with his housemates and friends, he gradually discovers new sides of the people around him. Each character has her own personality, ambitions, insecurities, and personal struggles.

Through humor, romance, drama, and meaningful choices, the protagonist's decisions shape his relationships and influence the course of his story.

Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/zrlgames
Itch io: https://zrlgames.itch.io/altera-via
